messages:
marta_sales: FYI - Prospect 'Nimbus' wants a reserved commit for production. Peak ~3k RPS chat, token mix ~70% short (~50 toks) / 30% long (~600 toks). They require AZ spread, preheat, and a legal-grade fallback plan.

lee_se: Which model(s)? That drives sizing and memory. Also need session stickiness expectations.

jun_ml: They plan 7B quantized as primary, 3B for low-latency fallbacks. Perf ballpark on our runtime: 7B ~1.2M tok/s per GPU, 3B ~2.0M tok/s. Avg toks/request ~210 -> ~630k tok/s at 3k RPS.

arun_eng: Ops margin + KV cold hits => recommend reserve 5 GPUs (spread across 3 AZs) and keep 2 burst vGPU credits. Autoscale policy: min_replicas=1 per AZ, scale up when util>75% for 30s, cooldown 5m.

infra_bot: Sim summary: reserve 5 GPUs (AZ distribution 2/2/1), burst pool 2, expected p95 ~220-280ms with batching and preheat.

lee_se: Sales needs a short contract line and pricing delta vs pure burst credits. I'll draft numbers once ops confirms.

jun_ml: Fallback sequence: (1) route long requests to 3B in-region; (2) trim outputs + lower max_tokens; (3) route non-critical traffic to hosted multi-tenant region; (4) return retry-after envelope. Ensure session_compat tags so conversations migrate safely.

arun_eng: Preheat runbook (summary): 30-45m window, synthetic ramp (20% -> 50% -> 80%), KV priming with customer top-500 prompts, smoke p95 checks, circuit-breaker if p99>1s -> trigger fallback.

rachel_security: Security snippet for questionnaire: "Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure), data plane encryption in transit & at rest, audit logs can be forwarded to customer SIEM with configurable retention; network isolation via VPC peering/private subnets."

marta_sales: Actions: Jun/Arun confirm final GPU count + attach perf doc by EOD; Lee -> pricing comparison (reserve 5+burst2 vs reserve 7) by EOD; Rachel -> paste KMS snippet into questionnaire. We'll align with customer tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
